Python lists are mutable. Build one with `append()`:

```python
items = []
for value in values:
    items.append(transform(value))
```

Use a list comprehension when the loop only transforms or filters values.

That scope is unlikely to succeed: a 40k-line rewrite, six weeks, one person, and ongoing feature delivery compete for the same capacity. Keep the Django system running, identify a bounded bottleneck or new service boundary, and replace it incrementally only where Go has a clear payoff. Define measurable goals first—latency, throughput, deployment isolation, or operating cost—then migrate one slice with a rollback path.

For a conventional B-tree index, `LIKE '%foo'` usually cannot use the index to seek efficiently because the unknown prefix prevents locating a starting range. The database may still scan the index, but that is not the same as a selective index lookup and may not be faster. Use a suffix/reversed-value index, full-text search, or trigram indexes where supported.

Remote work has not been universally proven to lower productivity; results depend on the work, management, tooling, and how productivity is measured. First identify the specific problem—missed coordination, slow onboarding, weak performance, or customer impact—then test targeted changes such as team anchor days, clearer operating norms, or better collaboration tooling. Phase out remote work only if evidence from your organization supports it and the benefit outweighs retention and hiring costs.

TCP guarantees ordered, reliable delivery within one connection—not across separate connections. Two sockets have independent streams, network paths, buffering, and scheduling, so their messages can arrive in either order. Add sequence numbers or a coordinator if cross-connection ordering matters.

No. Naming an individual in a postmortem tends to suppress reporting and misses the system conditions that allowed one config change to cause an outage. Write a blameless account of the change, detection gap, review and rollout controls, and concrete follow-ups: validation, staged deployment, automated rollback, alerting, and ownership with due dates. Address deliberate misconduct separately if that is actually involved.

CPython does not perform tail-call optimization. Python intentionally preserves stack frames for tracebacks and debugging, so even tail-recursive functions eventually raise `RecursionError`. Some languages and implementations do TCO, but it is not universal. In CPython, use an explicit loop for tail-recursive logic.

Microservices are not always the right architecture at scale. Split a monolith when a concrete boundary has independent deployment, scaling, reliability, ownership, or technology needs—and when the team can operate the added distributed-systems complexity. Team size alone is a poor trigger; many large teams succeed with a modular monolith.
